items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: That was in 1923 or 1924. And that's when he introduced the "Rhapsody in Blue" with George Gershwin playing it himself.

ctx.x: See, the only one that I know that had given a concert amongst the white musicians was Paul Whiteman. And I was at that concert. That was in 1923 or 1924. And that's when he introduced the "Rhapsody in Blue" with George Gershwin playing it himself. Well, outside of that, nobody else. Because see, we did not play everything in sync. In rhythm. We played it like it was, swing,
